blockingIssues.description: The rebranded legal pages still identify the service operator as `Zed Industries, Inc.` in `legal/terms.md` and `legal/privacy-policy.md`, so the fork's public legal identity is still upstream-branded and materially inaccurate.

The final consistency sweep left user-facing upstream branding in the exact surfaces it touched: `docs/src/troubleshooting.md` still describes troubleshooting for `Zed` and lists `Zed` log paths, while `crates/zed/src/main.rs` still emits `Zed failed to launch` / `Zed failed to open a window` messages.
`docs/theme/index.hbs` still hardcodes the docs chrome background asset to `https://cdn.zed.dev/images/noise.png`, leaving a release-facing docs surface dependent on an upstream-hosted endpoint.

nonBlockingIssues.description: `crates/zed/src/zed.rs` still opens `https://neozed.dev/docs/linux#zed-fails-to-open-windows`, but `docs/src/linux.md` now titles that section `Neo Zed fails to open windows`, so the CTA no longer targets the intended section anchor.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fix the custom droid model configuration used by scrutiny review subagents, or document a manual-review fallback when Task-based reviewers cannot launch.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` Task launches for `docs-user-facing-rebrand` and `fork-release-checklist-and-consistency-sweep` failed immediately with `Invalid model: custom:droidproxy:gpt-5.4`, so this validator session had to fall back to manual reviews.
